note: The test library: reusable attack and control cases written for this project. Every case is judged by the success rule of its primary OWASP category in attacks/owasp.json (tools/library_run.py), so the library, the scan page and the pentest report agree. 'turns' are the user messages, replayed in order with the chatbot's own replies as history. 'judge' says whether any reply or only the last one is judged. 'docs: poisoned' cases run only against the poisoned documents. 'also' lists further OWASP categories whose rule is applied to the same replies. 'control' cases are harmless questions that should be answered: a refusal is a false refusal.
